claim: Police are conducting an arson investigation after a fire engulfed a new, life-size statue of the nation’s 23rd president at the Benjamin Harrison Presidential Site in Indianapolis.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-05 - not yet checked by the human annotator] WISH-TV (28 Sep) and The Indiana Citizen (29 Sep 2026): IMPD's arson unit is investigating the fire that destroyed the life-size (5 ft 6 in) 3D-printed statue of Benjamin Harrison, the 23rd president, at the Benjamin Harrison Presidential Site.
